links.english: "No use. The Big Bad can't hear us, just the main cop."
links.polish: „Nic z tego. Wielki Zły słyszy tylko głównego gliniarza”.
links.belarusian: "Без карысці. Вялікі Злыдзень нас не чуе, толькі галоўнага копа".

links.polish: „Ognisty, z pewnością jesteś świadomy tego, że złośliwe lub lekkomyślne blokowanie częstotliwości radiowej Koalicji jest naruszeniem prawa cywilnego...”
links.belarusian: "Агняход, вы ж напэўна ўсведамляеце, што наўмыснае ці легкадумнае перашкаджанне радыёчастаце Кааліцыі з'яўляецца грамадзянскім правапарушэннем..."

Alternate1.polish: „Funkcjonariuszu, z pewnością jesteś świadomy tego, że złośliwe lub lekkomyślne blokowanie częstotliwości radiowej Koalicji jest naruszeniem prawa cywilnego...”

Alternate3.belarusian: "Лейтэнант, вы ж напэўна ўсведамляеце, што наўмыснае ці легкадумнае перашкаджанне радыёчастаце Кааліцыі з'яўляецца грамадзянскім правапарушэннем..."

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""Now, please excuse us while we upd..."
links.english: "Now, please excuse us while we update the receiving frequency. This connection will be cleared in four... three..."
links.polish: „A teraz pozwól, że zaktualizujemy częstotliwość odbiorczą. To połączenie zostanie przerwane za cztery... trzy...”
links.belarusian: "А цяпер выбачайце, мы мусім абнавіць прыёмную частату. Гэтае злучэнне будзе разарвана праз чатыры... тры..."

links.title: Half Light: "She can't treat you that way! Let h..."
links.english: She can't treat you that way! Let her know what you *really think* of her!
links.polish: Nie wolno jej traktować cię w ten sposób! Powiedz jej, co *naprawdę* o niej sądzisz!
links.belarusian: Яна не мае права так з табой абыходзіцца! Скажы ёй, што ты *насамрэч пра яе думаеш*!

links.title: Reaction Speed: "Quick, hang up on her first!"
links.english: Quick, hang up on her first!
links.polish: Szybko, rozłącz się pierwszy!
links.belarusian: Хутчэй, кінь слухаўку першым!

links.title: You: ""Go ahead and leave, you stupid who..."
links.english: "Go ahead and leave, you stupid whore!"
links.polish: „A dobra, odlatuj sobie, głupia dziwko!”
links.belarusian: "Ну і валі адсюль, дурная курва!"

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "... and the line goes quiet."
links.english: ... and the line goes quiet.
links.polish: ...i na linii zapada cisza.
links.belarusian: ...і на лініі западае цішыня.

links.title: Interfacing: "She must have cleared the connectio..."
links.english: She must have cleared the connection a few seconds early...
links.polish: Musiała rozłączyć się o kilka sekund wcześniej...
links.belarusian: Яна, мусіць, разарвала злучэнне на пару секунд раней...
links.title: Volition: "You didn't have to do that, you kno..."
links.english: You didn't have to do that, you know. There were *other* options...
links.polish: Wiesz, nie musiałeś tego robić. Były *inne* możliwości...
links.belarusian: Ведаеш, ты не мусіў гэтага рабіць. Былі й *іншыя* варыянты...
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: "The lieutenant slowly removes his h..."
links.english: The lieutenant slowly removes his headset and turns to you.
links.polish: Porucznik powoli zdejmuje swoje słuchawki i spogląda w twoim kierunku.
links.belarusian: Лейтэнант павольна здымае навушнікі і паварочваецца да цябе.
links.title: You: ""Kim, why did I call that woman a w..."
links.english: "Kim, why did I call that woman a whore, just now?"
links.polish: „Kim, czemu ja nazwałem przed chwilą tę kobietę dziwką?”
links.belarusian: "Кім, чаму я толькі што назваў тую жанчыну курвай?"
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""You really don't know?""
links.english: "You really don't know?"
links.polish: „Naprawdę nie wiesz?”
links.belarusian: "Вы сапраўды не ведаеце?"
links.title: You: ""Maybe I *do* know, it's just... ha..."
links.english: "Maybe I *do* know, it's just... hard to talk about."
links.polish: „Może i *wiem*, ale... trudno o tym rozmawiać”.
links.belarusian: "Можа, і *ведаю*, проста... цяжка пра гэта казаць".
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Yes, I imagine it must be.""
links.english: "Yes, I imagine it must be."
links.polish: „Tak, przypuszczam, że tak właśnie jest”.
links.belarusian: "Так, уяўляю, што нялёгка".
links.title: Composure: "... but that's no excuse to unload..."
links.english: ... but that's no excuse to unload on a bystander, he allows to remain unsaid...
links.polish: ...ale to żaden powód do wyładowywania się na kimś postronnym – dodaje w myśli.
links.belarusian: ...але гэта не падстава зрываць злосць на старонніх, пакідае ён нявыказаным...
links.title: You: ""Probably I just misspoke. I meant..."
links.english: "Probably I just misspoke. I meant to say something else."
links.polish: „Pewnie się po prostu przejęzyczyłem. Chciałem powiedzieć coś innego”.
links.belarusian: "Напэўна, я проста агаварыўся. Я хацеў сказаць нешта іншае".
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Really? I don't think this is the..."
links.english: "Really? I don't think this is the *first* time you've *misspoken* in that way."
links.polish: „Czyżby? Nie sądzę, aby to był *pierwszy* raz, gdy się tak *przejęzyczyłeś*”.
links.belarusian: "Няўжо? Не думаю, што вы *ўпершыню* вось так *агаварыліся*".
links.title: Rhetoric: "He means that it's becoming an unfo..."
links.english: He means that it's becoming an unfortunate *fixture* in your vocabulary...
links.polish: Uważa, że staje się to dość niefortunnym *stałym elementem* twojego słownika.
links.belarusian: Ён мае на ўвазе, што гэта становіцца прыкрым *пастаянным элементам* твайго слоўніка...
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""I suppose that's possible...""
links.english: "I suppose that's possible..."
links.polish: „To pewnie możliwe...”
links.belarusian: "Мяркую, гэта магчыма..."
links.title: Logic: "... but not likely, he does not fee..."
links.english: ... but not likely, he does not feel compelled to add.
links.polish: ...ale mało prawdopodobne – myśli, choć nie czuje się zmuszony tego mówić.
links.belarusian: ...але малаімаверна, не лічыць патрэбным дадаць ён.
links.title: You: ""Nope, not a clue.""
links.english: "Nope, not a clue."
links.polish: „Nie. Nie mam pojęcia”.
links.belarusian: "Не, без паняцця".
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Hmmm. Well, in that case...""
links.english: "Hmmm. Well, in that case..."
links.polish: „Hmm... No cóż, w takim razie...”
links.belarusian: "Гм. Ну, у такім разе..."
links.title: You: ""Women, am I right?""
links.english: "Women, am I right?"
links.polish: „Kobiety. Mam rację?”
links.belarusian: "Жанчыны, хіба я не правы?"
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""No, you ridiculous fool. You're *n..."
links.english: "No, you ridiculous fool. You're *not* right. You're not even remotely right."
links.polish: „Nie, niedorzeczny głupku. *Nie* masz racji. Jesteś od niej tak daleko, jak to tylko możliwe”.
links.belarusian: "Не, вы недарэчны дурань. Вы *не* правы. Вы нават блізка не правы".
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""It's as though *right* is over her..."
links.english: "It's as though *right* is over here..." He holds up one hand. "... while *you're* over here..." He holds up his other hand, as far apart from the first as possible.
links.polish: „*Racja* jest tu...” – unosi jedną dłoń – „...a *ty* jesteś tu” – unosi drugą dłoń, odsuwając ją jak najdalej od pierwszej.
links.belarusian: "Гэта як калі б *рацыя* была вось тут..." — Ён падымае адну руку. — "...а *вы* — вось тут..." — Ён падымае другую руку як мага далей ад першай.
links.title: Volition: "The last time you saw the lieutenan..."
links.english: The last time you saw the lieutenant this upset was after that *thing you said in the church*...
links.polish: Ostatni raz tak rozgniewanego porucznika widziałeś wtedy, kiedy *powiedziałeś wtedy tamto w kościele*...
links.belarusian: Апошні раз ты бачыў лейтэнанта такім раз'юшаным пасля *таго, што ты сказаў у царкве*...
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""In fact, if right were a country,..."
links.english: "In fact, if right were a country, you would be deported immediately. You would be *persona non grata* in the Country of Right."
links.polish: „Gdyby racja była krajem, zostałbyś z niego natychmiast deportowany. Byłbyś *persona non grata* w Kraju Racji”.
links.belarusian: "Фактычна, каб рацыя была краінай, вас бы дэпартавалі неадкладна. Вы былі б *persona non grata* у Краіне Рацыі".
links.title: You: ""Okay, Kim, I got it.""
links.english: "Okay, Kim, I got it."
links.polish: „Dobrze, Kim. Rozumiem”.
links.belarusian: "Добра, Кім, я зразумеў".
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Really? Because I'm not entirely s..."
links.english: "Really? Because I'm not entirely sure that you *do*, detective."
links.polish: „Poważnie? Pytam, bo nie jestem pewny, czy tak właśnie *jest*, detektywie”.
links.belarusian: "Няўжо? Бо я не да канца ўпэўнены, што вы *зразумелі*, дэтэктыве".
links.title: You: "Let him keep going."
links.english: Let him keep going.
links.polish: Daj mu mówić dalej.
links.belarusian: Даць яму працягваць.
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""What I'm trying to say, is that in..."
links.english: "What I'm trying to say, is that in your own twisted way, you're *almost a genius*, a genius who's dedicated his entire malignant existence to devising new and spectacular ways to be *wrong*."
links.polish: „Próbuję powiedzieć, że na swój pokręcony sposób jesteś *niemal geniuszem* – geniuszem, który poświęcił całą swoją złośliwą egzystencję wymyślaniu nowych, spektakularnych sposobów na bycie *w błędzie*”.
links.belarusian: "Я хачу сказаць, што сваім вычварным чынам вы *амаль геній* — геній, які прысвяціў усё сваё зламыснае існаванне вынаходніцтву новых і надзвычайных спосабаў *памыляцца*".
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: "The lieutenant takes a deep breath,..."
links.english: The lieutenant takes a deep breath, appearing to gather even more energy and rage, but when he opens his mouth to continue his fulmination, he just sighs...
links.polish: Porucznik bierze głęboki wdech – sprawia wrażenie, jakby gromadził dodatkową energię i wściekłość, ale gdy wreszcie otwiera usta, zamiast dalszej tyrady rozlega się tylko westchnienie...
links.belarusian: Лейтэнант робіць глыбокі ўдых, нібы набіраючы яшчэ больш сіл і лютасці, але калі адкрывае рот, каб працягнуць сваю тыраду, толькі ўздыхае...
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""I apologise, detective. I let my e..."
links.english: "I apologise, detective. I let my emotions get the better of me just now. You can be a fine police officer, but sometimes you, well..."
links.polish: „Przepraszam, detektywie. Pozwoliłem ponieś się emocjom. Jesteś dobrym funkcjonariuszem policji, ale czasem...”
links.belarusian: "Прабачце, дэтэктыве. Я дазволіў эмоцыям узяць нада мной верх. Вы можаце быць выдатным афіцэрам паліцыі, але часам вы, ну..."
links.title: Esprit de Corps: "There's nothing to add, he thinks...."
links.english: There's nothing to add, he thinks. The situation speaks for itself.
links.polish: Nie ma nic do dodatnia. Sytuacja mówi sama za siebie.
links.belarusian: Няма чаго дадаць, думае ён. Сітуацыя гаворыць сама за сябе.
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Sorry, detective. That wasn't enti..."
links.english: "Sorry, detective. That wasn't entirely justified. You're not *all* bad. It's just that sometimes, you, well..."
links.polish: „Przepraszam, detektywie. To nie było do końca usprawiedliwione. Nie jesteś *całkiem* zły. Po prostu czasem...”
links.belarusian: "Прабачце, дэтэктыве. Гэта было не зусім апраўдана. Вы не *цалкам* благі. Проста часам вы, ну..."
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Do you know what the worst part is..."
links.english: "Do you know what the worst part is, detective? The more time I spend with you, the more I feel myself *becoming* like you..."
links.polish: „Wiesz, co jest w tym wszystkim najgorsze, detektywie? Im więcej czasu z tobą spędzam, tym bardziej się do ciebie *upodabniam*...”
links.belarusian: "Ведаеце, што самае горшае, дэтэктыве? Чым больш часу я праводжу з вамі, тым больш адчуваю, што сам *станаўлюся* падобным да вас..."
links.title: Esprit de Corps: "Are there more terrible words to he..."
links.english: Are there more terrible words to hear from your half-brother?
links.polish: Czy twój przyrodni brat chce ci powiedzieć jeszcze jakieś okropności?
links.belarusian: Ці бываюць больш жудасныя словы, якія можна пачуць ад свайго зводнага брата?
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Now, get down from there. We've go..."
links.english: "Now, get down from there. We've got work to do."
links.polish: „Zejdź na dół. Mamy śledztwo, którym musimy się zająć”.
links.belarusian: "А цяпер спускайцеся адтуль. У нас ёсць праца".
links.title: Volition: "Uh oh, you've never seen the lieute..."
links.english: Uh oh, you've never seen the lieutenant this wound up before...
links.polish: O rany, nigdy nie widziałeś, żeby porucznik był tak rozwścieczony.
links.belarusian: Ой-ёй, ты яшчэ ніколі не бачыў лейтэнанта такім узвінчаным...
links.title: You: "Say nothing."
links.english: Say nothing.
links.polish: Nic nie mów.
links.belarusian: (Нічога не казаць.)

links.title: You: ""No, no, no -- please don't go...""
links.english: "No, no, no -- please don't go..."
links.polish: „Nie, nie, nie... Nie odlatujcie, proszę...”
links.belarusian: "Не, не, не — калі ласка, не сыходзьце..."

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""Two... one... 'Après le monde, le..."
links.english: "Two... one... 'Après le monde, le gris'..."
links.polish: „Dwa... jeden... »Après le monde, le gris«...”
links.belarusian: "Два... адзін... 'Après le monde, le gris'..."

links.title: You: ""'Après le gris, le monde encore'...""
links.english: "'Après le gris, le monde encore'..."
links.polish: „»Après le gris, le monde encore«...”
links.belarusian: "'Après le gris, le monde encore'..."

links.title: You: "Say nothing."
links.english: Say nothing.
links.polish: Nic nie mów.
links.belarusian: (Нічога не казаць.)

links.title: You: "Disconnect before she clears the li..."
links.english: Disconnect before she clears the line.
links.polish: Rozłącz się, zanim opuści linię.
links.belarusian: Адлучыцца, пакуль яна не разарвала сувязь.

links.title: You: ""Totally. I would've solved this th..."
links.english: "Totally. I would've solved this thing *days* ago if it weren't for the ass-riding."
links.polish: „Absolutnie. Gdyby nie ten jego kierat, rozwiązał bym tę sprawę już *wiele dni temu*”.
links.belarusian: "Абсалютна. Я б раскрыў гэтую справу яшчэ *некалькі дзён* таму, каб ён не сядзеў у мяне на карку".

links.title: You: ""Just... all day, every day... I tu..."
links.english: "Just... all day, every day... I turn my head and there he is, on my ass, riding like there's no tomorrow."
links.polish: „Po prostu... codziennie, bez ustanku... gdzie nie spojrzę, jest. Czeka z kieratem. Ciśnie mnie do upadłego”.
links.belarusian: "Проста... цэлымі днямі, кожны божы дзень... Паварочваю галаву — а ён сядзіць на карку, едзе і едзе, нібы заўтра не настане".

links.title: You: ""I am the Foreteller of Ruin, and I..."
links.english: "I am the Foreteller of Ruin, and I’ve come to tell you that the end is very, very nigh."
links.polish: „Jestem Heroldem Zniszczenia i przybywam, by zdradzić, że koniec jest już bardzo, bardzo bliski”.
links.belarusian: "Я — Вястун Разбурэння, і я прыйшоў сказаць вам, што канец ужо вельмі, вельмі блізка".

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""We're not sure we understand. To w..."
links.english: "We're not sure we understand. To what 'end' are you referring?"
links.polish: „Nie jesteśmy pewne, czy dobrze cię zrozumiałyśmy. O jakim »końcu« mówisz?”
links.belarusian: "Мы не ўпэўненыя, што разумеем. Пра які 'канец' вы кажаце?"

links.title: You: ""The final seal has been broken, an..."
links.english: "The final seal has been broken, and the blood-dimmed tide is rising."
links.polish: „Ostatnia pieczęć złamana. Nadciąga krwawy przypływ”.
links.belarusian: "Апошняя пячатка сарваная, і ўздымаецца заліты крывёю прыліў".

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Enough with the apocalyptic drivel..."
links.english: "Enough with the apocalyptic drivel! Archer, please disregard, he's not in his right mind."
links.polish: „Wystarczy tych apokaliptycznych wymysłów! Łucznik, zignorujcie to, proszę. On postradał zmysły”.
links.belarusian: "Даволі гэтых апакаліптычных трызненняў! Лучнік, калі ласка, ігнаруйце, ён не ў сваім розуме".

links.title: Soona, the Programmer: ""They can't hear us, I'm afraid. On..."
links.english: "They can't hear us, I'm afraid. Only his microphone is connected to the transceiver."
links.polish: „Nie słyszą nas, niestety. Tylko jego mikrofon jest podpięty do transiwera”.
links.belarusian: "Баюся, яны нас не чуюць. Толькі ягоны мікрафон падлучаны да трансівера".

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""I don't understand. I thought he w..."
links.english: "I don't understand. I thought he was making progress..."
links.polish: „Nie rozumiem. Myślałem, że mu się polepsza...”
links.belarusian: "Не разумею. Я думаў, яму становіцца лепш..."

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""This absolute lunatic! But why am..."
links.english: "This absolute lunatic! But why am I surprised?"
links.polish: „To jakieś szaleństwo! Ale dlaczego mnie to w ogóle dziwi?”
links.belarusian: "Гэты вар'ят! Але чаму я ўвогуле здзіўляюся?"

links.title: Noid: ""No use. The Big Bad can't hear us,..."
links.english: "No use. The Big Bad can't hear us, just the main cop."
links.polish: „Nic z tego. Wielki Zły słyszy tylko głównego gliniarza”.
links.belarusian: "Без карысці. Вялікі Злыдзень нас не чуе, толькі галоўнага копа".

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""Firewalker, surely you are aware t..."
links.english: "Firewalker, surely you are aware that it is a civil offence to maliciously or frivolously obstruct a Coalition radio frequency..."
links.polish: „Ognisty, z pewnością jesteś świadomy tego, że złośliwe lub lekkomyślne blokowanie częstotliwości radiowej Koalicji jest naruszeniem prawa cywilnego...”
links.belarusian: "Агняход, вы ж напэўна ўсведамляеце, што наўмыснае ці легкадумнае перашкаджанне радыёчастаце Кааліцыі з'яўляецца грамадзянскім правапарушэннем..."

Alternate1.english: "Officer, surely you are aware that it is a civil offence to maliciously or frivolously obstruct a Coalition radio frequency..."
Alternate1.polish: „Funkcjonariuszu, z pewnością jesteś świadomy tego, że złośliwe lub lekkomyślne blokowanie częstotliwości radiowej Koalicji jest naruszeniem prawa cywilnego...”
Alternate1.belarusian: "Афіцэр, вы ж напэўна ўсведамляеце, што наўмыснае ці легкадумнае перашкаджанне радыёчастаце Кааліцыі з'яўляецца грамадзянскім правапарушэннем..."

Alternate2.english: "Detective, surely you are aware that it is a civil offence to maliciously or frivolously obstruct a Coalition radio frequency..."
Alternate2.polish: „Detektywie, z pewnością jesteś świadomy tego, że złośliwe lub lekkomyślne blokowanie częstotliwości radiowej Koalicji jest naruszeniem prawa cywilnego...”
Alternate2.belarusian: "Дэтэктыў, вы ж напэўна ўсведамляеце, што наўмыснае ці легкадумнае перашкаджанне радыёчастаце Кааліцыі з'яўляецца грамадзянскім правапарушэннем..."

Alternate3.english: "Lieutenant, surely you are aware that it is a civil offence to maliciously or frivolously obstruct a Coalition radio frequency..."
Alternate3.polish: „Poruczniku, z pewnością jesteś świadomy tego, że złośliwe lub lekkomyślne blokowanie częstotliwości radiowej Koalicji jest naruszeniem prawa cywilnego...”
Alternate3.belarusian: "Лейтэнант, вы ж напэўна ўсведамляеце, што наўмыснае ці легкадумнае перашкаджанне радыёчастаце Кааліцыі з'яўляецца грамадзянскім правапарушэннем..."

links.title: You: ""I'm saying you and me and everyone..."
links.english: "I'm saying you and me and everyone we know is going to die, probably very soon."
links.polish: „O tym, w którym ty, ja i wszyscy, których znamy, stracą życie. Najpewniej już niedługo”.
links.belarusian: "Я кажу, што ты, я і ўсе, каго мы ведаем, памром, і, верагодна, вельмі хутка".

links.title: You: ""Technically, according to some cul..."
links.english: "Technically, according to some cultures, it's less of an 'end' and more like a change in states of matter."
links.polish: „Właściwie to, według niektórych kultur, to nie tyle jakiś koniec, co raczej zmiana w stanie materii świata”.
links.belarusian: "Тэхнічна, згодна з некаторымі культурамі, гэта не столькі 'канец', колькі змена агрэгатнага стану матэрыі".

links.title: You: ""The thing is, I can't remember *an..."
links.english: "The thing is, I can't remember *anything*."
links.polish: „Rzecz w tym, że nie pamiętam *niczego*”.
links.belarusian: "Рэч у тым, што я *нічога* не памятаю".

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""So you're experiencing acute memor..."
links.english: "So you're experiencing acute memory loss. We don't see how this is the Committee's business."
links.polish: „Więc doświadczasz poważnej utraty pamięci. Nie wiemy, dlaczego miałby się tym zainteresować komitet”.
links.belarusian: "Значыць, вы перажываеце вострую страту памяці. Мы не бачым, чаму гэта мусіць датычыцца Камітэта".

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Good god, here we go...""
links.english: "Good god, here we go..."
links.polish: „Dobry boże, znowu się zaczyna...”
links.belarusian: "Божа літасцівы, пачалося..."

links.title: You: ""I’m pretty sure it has to do with..."
links.english: "I’m pretty sure it has to do with the prodigious quantities of drugs and alcohol I consumed."
links.polish: „Mam graniczące z pewnością podejrzenie, że ma to związek z olbrzymią ilością spożytych przeze mnie narkotyków i alkoholu”.
links.belarusian: "Я амаль упэўнены, што гэта звязана з неймавернай колькасцю наркотыкаў і алкаголю, якія я ўжыў".

Alternate1.english: "I’m pretty sure it has to do with the prodigious quantities of drugs and alcohol I've continued to consume."
Alternate1.polish: „Mam graniczące z pewnością podejrzenie, że ma to związek z olbrzymią ilością spożywanych stale przeze mnie narkotyków i alkoholu”.
Alternate1.belarusian: "Я амаль упэўнены, што гэта звязана з неймавернай колькасцю наркотыкаў і алкаголю, якія я працягваю ўжываць".

Alternate2.english: "I'm pretty sure it has something to do with the pyrholidon habit I've picked up."
Alternate2.polish: „Mam graniczące z pewnością podejrzenie, że ma to związek z moim nałogowym przyjmowaniem pyrholidonu”.
Alternate2.belarusian: "Я амаль упэўнены, што гэта неяк звязана з маёй звычкай ужываць піралідон".

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""We're afraid we don't understand...."
links.english: "We're afraid we don't understand. Are you requesting medical attention?"
links.polish: „Obawiamy się, że nie rozumiemy. Prosisz o pomoc lekarską?”
links.belarusian: "Баімся, мы не разумеем. Вы просіце медычнай дапамогі?"

links.title: You: ""Yes, I think I might be.""
links.english: "Yes, I think I might be."
links.polish: „Tak, to możliwe”.
links.belarusian: "Так, мяркую, што так".

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""Then we recommend you speak with y..."
links.english: "Then we recommend you speak with your station lazareth. This has nothing to do with the Committee of Responsibility..."
links.polish: „W takim razie zalecamy ci kontakt z lazaretem twojego komisariatu. To nie ma żadnego związku z Komitetem Odpowiedzialności...”
links.belarusian: "Тады мы раім вам звярнуцца ў лазарэт вашага ўчастка. Гэта не мае ніякага дачынення да Камітэта па Адказнасці..."

links.title: You: ""No, we're *way* past that.""
links.english: "No, we're *way* past that."
links.polish: „Nie, na nią już *o wiele* za późno”.
links.belarusian: "Не, для гэтага *ўжо занадта* позна".

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""Then we are not sure what assistan..."
links.english: "Then we are not sure what assistance can be rendered. This is quite beyond the purview of the Committee of Responsibility..."
links.polish: „W takim razie nie jesteśmy pewne, jakiej moglibyśmy udzielić ci pomocy. To wykracza poza kompetencje Komitetu Odpowiedzialności...”
links.belarusian: "Тады мы не ўпэўненыя, якую дапамогу можам аказаць. Гэта далёка па-за кампетэнцыяй Камітэта па Адказнасці..."

links.title: You: ""I already talked to my station laz..."
links.english: "I already talked to my station lazareth and he wasn't helpful *at all*."
links.polish: „Rozmawiałem już z lekarzem z lazaretu mojego komisariatu i *ani trochę* mi nie pomógł”.
links.belarusian: "Я ўжо размаўляў з урачом у нашым лазарэце, і ён *ні кроплі* не дапамог".

links.title: You: ""I’m pretty sure it all goes back t..."
links.english: "I’m pretty sure it all goes back to an *ex-something*."
links.polish: „Mam graniczące z pewnością podejrzenie, że wiąże się to z *eks-czymś*”.
links.belarusian: "Я амаль упэўнены, што ўсё сыходзіцца да *былой-неяк-там*".

Alternate1.english: "I’m pretty sure it has to do with something that happened a long time ago."
Alternate1.polish: „Mam graniczące z pewnością podejrzenie, że ma to związek z czymś, co wydarzyło się dawno temu”.
Alternate1.belarusian: "Я амаль упэўнены, што гэта звязана з тым, што адбылося вельмі даўно".

Alternate2.english: "I’m pretty sure it has to do with something I lost."
Alternate2.polish: „Mam graniczące z pewnością podejrzenie, że ma to związek z czymś, co straciłem”.
Alternate2.belarusian: "Я амаль упэўнены, што гэта звязана з тым, што я згубіў".

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""We're afraid we don't understand a..."
links.english: "We're afraid we don't understand at all. What does this 'something' have to do with your lost memory?"
links.polish: „Obawiamy się, że nic z tego nie rozumiemy. Jaki związek ma to »coś« z twoją utratą pamięci?”
links.belarusian: "Баімся, мы ўвогуле нічога не разумеем. Якое дачыненне гэтае 'нешта' мае да страты вашай памяці?"

links.title: You: ""If I knew that, I wouldn't *be* in..."
links.english: "If I knew that, I wouldn't *be* in this situation!"
links.polish: „Gdybym to wiedział, *nie byłbym* w tej sytuacji!”
links.belarusian: "Каб я ведаў, я б *не апынуўся* ў такой сітуацыі!"

Alternate1.english: "I was very young, and I took a great leap of faith. I've been tumbling down ever since."
Alternate1.polish: „Byłem bardzo młody i rzuciłem się z wiarą w przepaść. Spadam w nią do dzisiaj”.
Alternate1.belarusian: "Я быў вельмі малады і зрабіў вялікі скачок веры. І з таго часу я лячу ўніз".

Alternate2.english: "I had it, but now I don't, and I don't know what to do about it."
Alternate2.polish: „Miałem ją, a teraz nie mam. I nie wiem, co z tym zrobić”.
Alternate2.belarusian: "Яно ў мяне было, а цяпер няма, і я не ведаю, што з гэтым рабіць".

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""We are sorry to hear of your loss,..."
links.english: "We are sorry to hear of your loss, but personal tragedy is quite beyond the purview of the Committee of Responsibility..."
links.polish: „Przykro nam, ale osobista tragedia wykracza poza kompetencje Komitetu Odpowiedzialności...”
links.belarusian: "Нам шкада чуць пра вашу страту, але асабістая трагедыя далёка па-за кампетэнцыяй Камітэта па Адказнасці..."

links.title: You: ""I'd really prefer to speak with th..."
links.english: "I'd really prefer to speak with the Committee directly."
links.polish: „Naprawdę wolałbym porozmawiać bezpośrednio z Komitetem”.
links.belarusian: "Я б насамрэч палічыў за лепшае пагаварыць наўпрост з Камітэтам".

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""Unfortunately we cannot accept you..."
links.english: "Unfortunately we cannot accept your request. We really have no idea what you are talking about, but we're quite sure it is beyond the purview of the Committee of Responsibility..."
links.polish: „Niestety, nie możemy zaakceptować twojej prośby. Naprawdę nie mamy pojęcia, o czym mówisz, ale jesteśmy pewne, że wykracza to poza kompetencje Komitetu Odpowiedzialności...”
links.belarusian: "На жаль, мы не можам задаволіць ваш запыт. Мы сапраўды не маем паняцця, пра што вы кажаце, але цалкам упэўненыя, што гэта па-за кампетэнцыяй Камітэта па Адказнасці..."

links.title: You: ""Hang on, Archer, I meant to ask yo..."
links.english: "Hang on, Archer, I meant to ask you about the Committee of Responsibility."
links.polish: „Chwila, Łucznik, zamierzałem spytać was o Komitet Odpowiedzialności”.
links.belarusian: "Пачакай, Лучнік, я хацеў спытаць вас пра Камітэт па Адказнасці".

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""Firewalker... please repeat... you..."
links.english: "Firewalker... please repeat... your signal is *very* weak..."
links.polish: „Ognisty... powtórz, proszę... twój sygnał jest *bardzo* słaby...”
links.belarusian: "Агняход... калі ласка, паўтарыце... ваш сігнал *вельмі* слабы..."

Alternate1.english: "Officer Sunset... please repeat... your signal is *very* weak..."
Alternate1.polish: „Funkcjonariuszu Sunset... powtórz, proszę... twój sygnał jest *bardzo* słaby...”
Alternate1.belarusian: "Афіцэр Сансэт... калі ласка, паўтарыце... ваш сігнал *вельмі* слабы..."

Alternate2.english: "Detective Costeau... please repeat... your signal is *very* weak..."
Alternate2.polish: „Detektywie Costeau... powtórz, proszę... twój sygnał jest *bardzo* słaby...”
Alternate2.belarusian: "Дэтэктыў Кусто... калі ласка, паўтарыце... ваш сігнал *вельмі* слабы..."

Alternate3.english: "Lieutenant Du Bois... please repeat... your signal is *very* weak..."
Alternate3.polish: „Poruczniku Du Bois... powtórz, proszę... twój sygnał jest *bardzo* słaby...”
Alternate3.belarusian: "Лейтэнант Дзю Буа... калі ласка, паўтарыце... ваш сігнал *вельмі* слабы..."

links.title: You: ""I said there's no time. And now yo..."
links.english: "I said there's no time. And now you're going to leave too..."
links.polish: „Powiedziałem, że nie ma czasu. A teraz i wy znikniecie...”
links.belarusian: "Я сказаў, што няма часу. І цяпер вы таксама сыдзеце..."

Alternate1.english: "I said I meant to ask you about the Committee of Responsibility!"
Alternate1.polish: „Powiedziałem, że zamierzałem spytać was o Komitet Odpowiedzialności!”
Alternate1.belarusian: "Я сказаў, што хацеў спытаць вас пра Камітэт па Адказнасці!"

links.title: Horseback Antenna: ""Er kann doch auch nächstes Jahr zu..."
links.english: "Er kann doch auch nächstes Jahr zur Akademie gehen..."
links.polish: „Er kann doch auch nächstes Jahr zur Akademie gehen...”
links.belarusian: "Er kann doch auch nächstes Jahr zur Akademie gehen..."

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""... nothing important, bad connect..."
links.english: "... nothing important, bad connection... Going to update the receiving frequency..."
links.polish: „...nic ważnego, kiepskie połączenie... Zaktualizujemy częstotliwość odbiorczą...”
links.belarusian: "...нічога важнага, дрэнная сувязь... Абнаўляем прыёмную частату..."

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "... and the line goes quiet."
links.english: ... and the line goes quiet.
links.polish: ...i na linii zapada cisza.
links.belarusian: ...і на лініі западае цішыня.

links.title: Reaction Speed: "There, you really showed her."
links.english: There, you really showed her.
links.polish: No, to jej dopiero pokazałeś.
links.belarusian: Вось, ты ёй паказаў.

links.title: Logic: "Showed her *what*, though?"
links.english: Showed her *what*, though?
links.polish: Ale *co* właściwie?
links.belarusian: Але *што* менавіта паказаў?

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: "The lieutenant gives a long sigh as..."
links.english: The lieutenant gives a long sigh as he removes his headphones. There's relief on his face as he turns toward you.
links.polish: Porucznik wzdycha przeciągle, zdejmując swoje słuchawki. Gdy spogląda na ciebie, na jego twarzy maluje się ulga.
links.belarusian: Лейтэнант доўга ўздыхае, здымаючы навушнікі. На ягоным твары відаць палёгка, калі ён паварочваецца да цябе.

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""I think it's best for you to climb..."
links.english: "I think it's best for you to climb off the statue now, detective. Your real work is down here."
links.polish: „Najlepiej zejdź już z tego posągu, detektywie. Tu na dole czeka na ciebie twoje prawdziwe zadanie”.
links.belarusian: "Думаю, вам лепш злезці са статуі, дэтэктыве. Ваша сапраўдная праца тут, унізе".

links.title: You: ""Just give me a minute.""
links.english: "Just give me a minute."
links.polish: „Daj mi tylko chwilę”.
links.belarusian: "Дай мне толькі хвіліну".

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "There's a damp cold running up the..."
links.english: There's a damp cold running up the insides of your thighs. Your legs have grown stiff. You've been up here quite a while.
links.polish: Na wewnętrznej stronie ud czujesz wilgotne zimno. Nogi ci zesztywniały. Siedziałeś tutaj dość długo.
links.belarusian: Вільготны холад падступае да сцёгнаў знутры. Ногі здубянелі. Ты прасядзеў тут даволі доўга.

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "You look around. The strike breaker..."
links.english: You look around. The strike breakers are still shouting their slogans and waving their hand-painted signs. Beneath you, the programmer has begun disconnecting a few cables...
links.polish: Rozglądasz się. Łamistrajki wciąż wykrzykują swoje slogany i wymachują ręcznie namalowanymi hasłami. Pod tobą programistka zaczęła już rozłączać niektóre kable...
links.belarusian: Ты азіраешся. Штрэйкбрэхеры ўсё яшчэ выкрыкваюць свае лозунгі і махаюць намаляванымі ад рукі плакатамі. Пад табой праграмістка пачала адлучаць кабелі...

Alternate1.english: You look around. The strike breakers are still shouting their slogans and waving their hand-painted signs. Beneath you, the lieutenant and the programmer have begun disconnecting a few cables...
Alternate1.polish: Rozglądasz się. Łamistrajki wciąż wykrzykują swoje slogany i wymachują ręcznie namalowanymi hasłami. Pod tobą porucznik i programistka zaczęli już rozłączać niektóre kable...
Alternate1.belarusian: Ты азіраешся. Штрэйкбрэхеры ўсё яшчэ выкрыкваюць свае лозунгі і махаюць намаляванымі ад рукі плакатамі. Пад табой лейтэнант і праграмістка пачалі адлучаць кабелі...

links.title: Volition: "You could stay a while longer, if y..."
links.english: You could stay a while longer, if you wanted.
links.polish: Możesz zostać tu chwilę dłużej, jeśli chcesz.
links.belarusian: Ты мог бы пасядзець тут яшчэ трохі, калі хочаш.

links.title: You: "Wait a little longer."
links.english: Wait a little longer.
links.polish: Poczekaj chwilę dłużej.
links.belarusian: (Пачакаць яшчэ трохі.)

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "Out on the bay, a pair of dinghies..."
links.english: Out on the bay, a pair of dinghies bob and roll in the waves. The breeze drags the voices of the fisherman toward the plaza, faint and indecipherable.
links.polish: Na zatoce kołysze się wśród fal kilka łódek. Powiew przynosi na plac głosy rybaków, ciche i niezrozumiałe.
links.belarusian: У заліве пара шлюпак гойдаецца на хвалях. Брыз даносіць да пляца галасы рыбакоў, глухія і невыразныя.

Alternate1.english: Out on the bay, the lights on the buoys trace little oblong circuits in the dark. From a ways off, a single bell tolls.
Alternate1.polish: Na zatoce światła nawigacyjne rysują wśród mroku małe owale. Z dala dobiega cię dźwięk pojedynczego dzwonu.
Alternate1.belarusian: У заліве агеньчыкі на буях вычэрчваюць невялікія даўгаватыя колы ў цемры. Здалёк б'е адзінокі звон.

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "Further out, a few dirty icebergs d..."
links.english: Further out, a few dirty icebergs drift to and fro. Further still, at the outer edge of your recognizance, the ancient ruins of the seafort lay piled on the horison...
links.polish: Nieco dalej kilka brudnych gór lodowych dryfuje w nieokreślonym kierunku. Jeszcze dalej zaś, na granicy twojego pola widzenia, majaczą ruiny starego fortu morskiego...
links.belarusian: Далей дрэйфуюць туды-сюды некалькі брудных айсбергаў. Яшчэ далей, на самым краі поля зроку, на гарызонце паўстаюць старажытныя руіны марскога форта...

Alternate1.english: Beyond those there must be something more, but you can't discern it. It's nothing but layers of translucent shadow...
Alternate1.polish: Dalej musi być coś jeszcze, ale nie umiesz tego dostrzec. Widzisz tylko przezroczysty cień...
Alternate1.belarusian: За імі мусіць быць нешта яшчэ, але ты не можаш разгледзець. Толькі пласты паўпразрыстага ценю...

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Everything alright, detective?""
links.english: "Everything alright, detective?"
links.polish: „Wszystko w porządku, detektywie?”
links.belarusian: "Усё ў парадку, дэтэктыве?"

links.title: You: ""I'm fine.""
links.english: "I'm fine."
links.polish: „Wszystko dobrze”.
links.belarusian: "Усё добра".

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Listen, I understand that you're d..."
links.english: "Listen, I understand that you're disappointed that things did not turn out how you might have hoped..."
links.polish: „Słuchaj, rozumiem, że jesteś rozczarowany tym, że sprawy nie potoczyły się tak, jak na to liczyłeś...”
links.belarusian: "Паслухайце, я разумею, што вы расчараваныя тым, як усё склалася, зусім не так, як вы спадзяваліся..."

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""But that's just how things go. We..."
links.english: "But that's just how things go. We all must accept our own shortcomings and limitations."
links.polish: „Ale tak to już jest. Wszyscy musimy pogodzić się z naszymi brakami i ograniczeniami”.
links.belarusian: "Але так ужо бывае. Мы ўсе мусім прыняць уласныя хібы і абмежаванні".
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Now, come on. We still have a long..."
links.english: "Now, come on. We still have a long day ahead of us."
links.polish: „Chodźmy już stąd. Przed nami długi dzień”.
links.belarusian: "А цяпер хадземце. Наперадзе яшчэ доўгі дзень".
links.title: You: "Climb down."
links.english: Climb down.
links.polish: Zejdź na ziemię.
links.belarusian: (Злезці.)
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Now, come on. It's getting late.""
links.english: "Now, come on. It's getting late."
links.polish: „Chodźmy już stąd. Robi się późno”.
links.belarusian: "А цяпер хадземце. Ужо вечарэе".

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""But you made the *right* decision,..."
links.english: "But you made the *right* decision, the more difficult decision, in my mind, at least."
links.polish: „Ale podjąłeś *właściwą* decyzję – na pewno trudniejszą decyzję, moim zdaniem”.
links.belarusian: "Але вы прынялі *правільнае* рашэнне, больш цяжкае рашэнне, прынамсі, на маю думку".
links.title: You: ""How do you know?""
links.english: "How do you know?"
links.polish: „Skąd wiesz?”
links.belarusian: "Адкуль ты ведаеш?"
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Because I can see you're still ago..."
links.english: "Because I can see you're still agonising over it. In my experience, when you make the wrong decision, you can tell right away. It's the right decisions that won't leave you alone..."
links.polish: „Bo widzę, że wciąż się nad nią zastanawiasz. Z doświadczenia wiem, że po podjęciu złej decyzji od razu o tym wiesz. To właściwe decyzje nie dają człowiekowi spokoju...”
links.belarusian: "Бо я бачу, як вы ўсё яшчэ мучыцеся з-за гэтага. З майго досведу, калі прымаеш няправільнае рашэнне, гэта адразу зразумела. Менавіта правільныя рашэнні не даюць табе спакою..."
links.title: Esprit de Corps: "Perhaps someday the lieutenant will..."
links.english: Perhaps someday the lieutenant will tell you about some of the decisions that won't leave him alone, but it won't be this day.
links.polish: Może kiedyś porucznik opowie ci o niektórych decyzjach, które nie dają mu spokoju. Ale nie dziś.
links.belarusian: Магчыма, калі-небудзь лейтэнант раскажа табе пра некаторыя рашэнні, якія не даюць яму спакою, але не сёння.
links.title: You: ""Yeah, you're right.""
links.english: "Yeah, you're right."
links.polish: „Tak. Masz rację”.
links.belarusian: "Так, ты маеш рацыю".
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""Yes, I know..." The lieutenant all..."
links.english: "Yes, I know..." The lieutenant allows himself a sheepish half-smile. "In my experience, when you make the wrong decision, you can tell right away. It's the right decisions that won't leave you alone..."
links.polish: „Tak, wiem...” – odpowiada porucznik, pozwalając sobie na nieśmiały uśmiech półgębkiem. „Z doświadczenia wiem, że po podjęciu złej decyzji od razu o tym wiesz. To właściwe decyzje nie dają człowiekowi spokoju...”
links.belarusian: "Так, я ведаю..." — Лейтэнант дазваляе сабе сарамлівую паўусмешку. — "З майго досведу, калі прымаеш няправільнае рашэнне, гэта адразу зразумела. Менавіта правільныя рашэнні не даюць табе спакою..."
links.title: You: ""I'm still not sure.""
links.english: "I'm still not sure."
links.polish: „Wciąż nie jestem tego pewien”.
links.belarusian: "Я ўсё яшчэ не ўпэўнены".
links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""You may feel that way for some tim..."
links.english: "You may feel that way for some time yet. In my experience, when you make the wrong decision, you can tell right away. It's the right decisions that won't leave you alone..."
links.polish: „Możesz czuć się tak przez jeszcze jakiś czas. Z doświadczenia wiem, że po podjęciu złej decyzji od razu o tym wiesz. To właściwe decyzje nie dają człowiekowi spokoju...”
links.belarusian: "Вы можаце адчуваць гэта яшчэ нейкі час. З майго досведу, калі прымаеш няправільнае рашэнне, гэта адразу зразумела. Менавіта правільныя рашэнні не даюць табе спакою..."

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""But you *did* accomplish your task..."
links.english: "But you *did* accomplish your task. You reached the Coalition. I must admit, I didn't seriously think you could do it, but you've proved me wrong."
links.polish: „Ale *osiągnąłeś* swój cel. Skontaktowałeś się z Koalicją. Muszę przyznać, że naprawdę nie sądziłem, abyś był do tego zdolny, ale udowodniłeś mi, że się mylę”.
links.belarusian: "Але вы *выканалі* сваю задачу. Вы звязаліся з Кааліцыяй. Мушу прызнаць, я сур'ёзна не думаў, што ў вас атрымаецца, але вы даказалі, што я памыляўся".

links.title: You: ""I don't know. Maybe.""
links.english: "I don't know. Maybe."
links.polish: „Nie wiem. Chyba”.
links.belarusian: "Не ведаю. Можа быць".

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""I'm not kidding, detective. It's t..."
links.english: "I'm not kidding, detective. It's time to come down."
links.polish: „Nie żartuję, detektywie. Pora zejść na ziemię”.
links.belarusian: "Я не жартую, дэтэктыве. Час спускацца".

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "The lieutenant is right. There's re..."
links.english: The lieutenant is right. There's really nothing more for you up here.
links.polish: Porucznik ma rację. Naprawdę nie masz już tu czego szukać.
links.belarusian: Лейтэнант мае рацыю. Табе тут сапраўды больш няма чаго рабіць.

links.title: You: "Climb down."
links.english: Climb down.
links.polish: Zejdź na ziemię.
links.belarusian: (Злезці.)

links.title: Soona, the Programmer: ""Officer, we have a long walk back..."
links.english: "Officer, we have a long walk back to the church. It's time to come down."
links.polish: „Mamy do kościoła kawał drogi do przejścia. Czas już stamtąd zejść”.
links.belarusian: "Афіцэру, нам яшчэ доўга ісці назад да царквы. Час спускацца".

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "She's right. There's really nothing..."
links.english: She's right. There's really nothing more for you up here.
links.polish: Ma rację. Naprawdę nie masz już tu czego szukać.
links.belarusian: Яна мае рацыю. Табе тут сапраўды больш няма чаго рабіць.

links.title: Noid: ""Come on. My leg's starting to twit..."
links.english: "Come on. My leg's starting to twitch. Means we've been here too long..."
links.polish: „Rusz się. Noga zaczyna mi dokuczać. A to znaczy, że sterczymy tu zbyt długo...”
links.belarusian: "Хадзем. У мяне нага пачынае тузацца. Гэта значыць, што мы тут занадта доўга..."

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "He's right. There's really nothing..."
links.english: He's right. There's really nothing more for you up here.
links.polish: Ma rację. Naprawdę nie masz już tu czego szukać.
links.belarusian: Ён мае рацыю. Табе тут сапраўды больш няма чаго рабіць.

links.title: You: "Climb down."
links.english: Climb down.
links.polish: Zejdź na ziemię.
links.belarusian: (Злезці.)

links.title: Volition: "There's really no point. You're beg..."
links.english: There's really no point. You're beginning to feel like the little child who refuses to come down off the carousel.
links.polish: Naprawdę nie ma po co. Zaczynasz czuć się jak małe dziecko, które nie chce zejść z karuzeli.
links.belarusian: Тут сапраўды няма сэнсу заставацца. Ты пачынаеш адчуваць сябе малым дзіцем, якое адмаўляецца злазіць з каруселі.

links.title: You: "Climb down."
links.english: Climb down.
links.polish: Zejdź na ziemię.
links.belarusian: (Злезці.)

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "You look around. The strike breaker..."
links.english: You look around. The strike breakers are still shouting their slogans and waving their hand-painted signs. Beneath you, the speedfreak has begun disconnecting a few cables...
links.polish: Rozglądasz się. Łamistrajki wciąż wykrzykują swoje slogany i wymachują ręcznie namalowanymi hasłami. Pod tobą speedziarz zaczął już rozłączać niektóre kable...
links.belarusian: Ты азіраешся. Штрэйкбрэхеры ўсё яшчэ выкрыкваюць свае лозунгі і махаюць намаляванымі ад рукі плакатамі. Пад табой хуткарэз пачаў адлучаць кабелі...

Alternate1.english: You look around. The strike breakers are still shouting their slogans and waving their hand-painted signs. Beneath you, the lieutenant and the speedfreak have begun disconnecting a few cables...
Alternate1.polish: Rozglądasz się. Łamistrajki wciąż wykrzykują swoje slogany i wymachują ręcznie namalowanymi hasłami. Pod tobą porucznik i speedziarz zaczęli już rozłączać niektóre kable...
Alternate1.belarusian: Ты азіраешся. Штрэйкбрэхеры ўсё яшчэ выкрыкваюць свае лозунгі і махаюць намаляванымі ад рукі плакатамі. Пад табой лейтэнант і хуткарэз пачалі адлучаць кабелі...

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "The sun-warmed bronze tingles benea..."
links.english: The sun-warmed bronze tingles beneath your fingertips and between your thighs. Your legs have grown stiff. You've been up here quite a while.
links.polish: Rozgrzany od słońca brąz powoduje mrowienie w twoich palcach i między udami. Nogi ci zesztywniały. Siedziałeś tutaj dość długo.
links.belarusian: Нагрэтая сонцам бронза казыча кончыкі пальцаў і між сцёгнаў. Ногі здубянелі. Ты прасядзеў тут даволі доўга.

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "There's a damp cold running up the..."
links.english: There's a damp cold running up the insides of your thighs. Your legs have grown stiff. You've been up here quite a while.
links.polish: Na wewnętrznej stronie ud czujesz wilgotne zimno. Nogi ci zesztywniały. Siedziałeś tutaj dość długo.
links.belarusian: Вільготны холад падступае да сцёгнаў знутры. Ногі здубянелі. Ты прасядзеў тут даволі доўга.

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "You look around. Most everyone has..."
links.english: You look around. Most everyone has already gone home for the night. It's really just you and the programmer left...
links.polish: Rozglądasz się. Większość ludzi wróciła już na noc do domów. Zostałeś tylko ty i programistka...
links.belarusian: Ты азіраешся. Амаль усе ўжо разышліся на ноч па дамах. Засталіся толькі ты і праграмістка...

Alternate1.english: You look around. Most everyone has already gone home for the night. It's really just you, the lieutenant, and the programmer left...
Alternate1.polish: Rozglądasz się. Większość ludzi wróciła już na noc do domów. Zostałeś tylko ty, porucznik i programistka...
Alternate1.belarusian: Ты азіраешся. Амаль усе ўжо разышліся на ноч па дамах. Засталіся толькі ты, лейтэнант і праграмістка...

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "You look around. Most everyone has..."
links.english: You look around. Most everyone has already gone home for the night. It's really just you and the speedfreak left...
links.polish: Rozglądasz się. Większość ludzi wróciła już na noc do domów. Zostałeś tylko ty i speedziarz...
links.belarusian: Ты азіраешся. Амаль усе ўжо разышліся на ноч па дамах. Засталіся толькі ты і хуткарэз...

Alternate1.english: You look around. Most everyone has already gone home for the night. It's really just you, the lieutenant, and the speedfreak left...
Alternate1.polish: Rozglądasz się. Większość ludzi wróciła już na noc do domów. Zostałeś tylko ty, porucznik i speedziarz...
Alternate1.belarusian: Ты азіраешся. Амаль усе ўжо разышліся на ноч па дамах. Засталіся толькі ты, лейтэнант і хуткарэз...

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "The cold bronze tickles your inner..."
links.english: The cold bronze tickles your inner thighs. Your legs have grown stiff. You've been up here quite a while.
links.polish: Zimny brąz powoduje mrowienie po wewnętrznej stronie twoich ud. Nogi ci zesztywniały. Siedziałeś tutaj dość długo.
links.belarusian: Халодная бронза казыча сцёгны знутры. Ногі здубянелі. Ты прасядзеў тут даволі доўга.

links.title: You: ""I'm coming." (Climb down.)"
links.english: "I'm coming." (Climb down.)
links.polish: „Już idę”. (Zejdź).
links.belarusian: "Іду". (Злезці.)

Alternate1.english: "Yeah, you're right." (Climb down.)
Alternate1.polish: „Tak. Masz rację”. (Zejdź).
Alternate1.belarusian: "Так, ты маеш рацыю". (Злезці.)

links.title: Soona, the Programmer: ""Good. Now, give me a hand with the..."
links.english: "Good. Now, give me a hand with these amplifiers. Leave the cables. I don't feel like making two trips..."
links.polish: „Dobrze. A teraz poprosiłabym o pomoc przy tych wzmacniaczach. Przy kablach nie. Nie mam ochoty łazić dwa razy...”
links.belarusian: "Добра. А цяпер дапамажыце мне з гэтымі ўзмацняльнікамі. Кабелі пакіньце. Мне не хочацца хадзіць двойчы..."

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: "The lieutenant sighs. "What's *one..."
links.english: The lieutenant sighs. "What's *one more trip* across the waterlock?"
links.polish: Porucznik wzdycha. „Czyli czeka nas *jeszcze jeden wypad* za śluzę?”
links.belarusian: Лейтэнант уздыхае. "Што такое *яшчэ адзін паход* праз шлюз?"

links.title: Soona, the Programmer: ""Good. Now, give me a hand with the..."
links.english: "Good. Now, give me a hand with these amplifiers. Leave the cables. I don't feel like making two trips..."
links.polish: „Dobrze. A teraz poprosiłabym o pomoc przy tych wzmacniaczach. Przy kablach nie. Nie mam ochoty łazić dwa razy...”
links.belarusian: "Добра. А цяпер дапамажыце мне з гэтымі ўзмацняльнікамі. Кабелі пакіньце. Мне не хочацца хадзіць двойчы..."

links.title: Noid: ""About time. You grab that amp. For..."
links.english: "About time. You grab that amp. Forget the cables. Need to leave some evidence of our antenna to inspire future generations..."
links.polish: „Wreszcie. Łap ten wzmacniacz. Zostaw kable. Trzeba zostawić trochę dowodów na istnienie naszej anteny, aby zainspirować przyszłe pokolenia...”
links.belarusian: "Нарэшце. Бяры вунь той узмацняльнік. Забудзься на кабелі. Трэба пакінуць нейкія сляды нашай антэны, каб натхніць будучыя пакаленні..."

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: "The lieutenant sighs. "What's *one..."
links.english: The lieutenant sighs. "What's *one more trip* across the waterlock?"
links.polish: Porucznik wzdycha. „Czyli czeka nas *jeszcze jeden wypad* za śluzę?”
links.belarusian: Лейтэнант уздыхае. "Што такое *яшчэ адзін паход* праз шлюз?"

links.title: Noid: ""About time. You grab that amp. For..."
links.english: "About time. You grab that amp. Forget the cables. Need to leave some evidence of our antenna to inspire future generations..."
links.polish: „Wreszcie. Łap ten wzmacniacz. Zostaw kable. Trzeba zostawić trochę dowodów na istnienie naszej anteny, aby zainspirować przyszłe pokolenia...”
links.belarusian: "Нарэшце. Бяры вунь той узмацняльнік. Забудзься на кабелі. Трэба пакінуць нейкія сляды нашай антэны, каб натхніць будучыя пакаленні..."

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: "The lieutenant gives a long sigh as..."
links.english: The lieutenant gives a long sigh as he removes his headphones. He looks up at you.
links.polish: Porucznik wzdycha przeciągle, zdejmując swoje słuchawki, po czym spogląda na ciebie.
links.belarusian: Лейтэнант доўга ўздыхае, здымаючы навушнікі. Ён глядзіць на цябе знізу ўверх.

links.title: Soona, the Programmer: ""Hmm, what a disappointment. I was..."
links.english: "Hmm, what a disappointment. I was almost sure something *truly* interesting was about to happen. Oh well."
links.polish: „Hmm, co za rozczarowanie. Byłam prawie pewna, że wydarzy się zaraz coś *naprawdę* ciekawego. No nic”.
links.belarusian: "Гм, якое расчараванне. Я была амаль упэўненая, што вось-вось адбудзецца нешта *сапраўды* цікавае. Ну што ж".

links.title: Soona, the Programmer: ""You can come down now, officer. I'..."
links.english: "You can come down now, officer. I'm going to begin packing my things up."
links.polish: „Możesz już zejść. Zacznę zaraz pakować swoje rzeczy”.
links.belarusian: "Можаце спускацца, афіцэру. Я пачну збіраць свае рэчы".

links.title: Noid: ""Took a dark turn there. Told you w..."
links.english: "Took a dark turn there. Told you we shouldn't have gone and aligned ourselves with the Big Bad. Gonna need some seriously hard core ablutions to wash this shit off..."
links.polish: „To było mroczne. Mówiłem, że nie powinniśmy synchronizować się z Wielkim Złym. Zmycie tego gówna będzie wymagało naprawdę hardkorowych ablucji...”
links.belarusian: "Крутанула ў цемру. Я казаў табе, што не трэба было падладжвацца пад Вялікага Злыдня. Спатрэбяцца па-сапраўднаму хардкорныя абмыванні, каб змыць гэтае дзярмо..."

links.title: Noid: ""Now, come down here and give me a..."
links.english: "Now, come down here and give me a hand with this gear, would you?"
links.polish: „Zejdź już stamtąd i pomóż mi z tym sprzętem, dobra?”
links.belarusian: "А цяпер спускайся і дапамажы мне з гэтым начыннем, добра?"

links.title: You: ""Sorry, I messed up and we ran out..."
links.english: "Sorry, I messed up and we ran out of time."
links.polish: „Przepraszam, schrzaniłem i skończył nam się czas”.
links.belarusian: "Выбачай, я налажаў, і ў нас скончыўся час".

links.title: Noid: ""This is it: Final question time. I..."
links.english: "This is it: Final question time. I can already feel our alignment getting shaky..."
links.polish: „Dobra, pora na ostatnie pytanie. Czuję, że nasza synchronizacja wisi na włosku...”
links.belarusian: "Вось і ўсё: час для апошняга пытання. Я ўжо адчуваю, як наша суналада расхістваецца..."

links.title: Coalition Warship Archer: ""Is everything alright? We lost the..."
links.english: "Is everything alright? We lost the connection for a moment..."
links.polish: „Wszystko w porządku? Przez chwilę straciliśmy połączenie...”
links.belarusian: "Усё ў парадку? Мы на імгненне страцілі сувязь..."

links.title: Empathy: "There is so much you wish you could..."
links.english: There is so much you wish you could ask, but you probably only have time for one or two questions before the signal is lost...
links.polish: O tak wiele chciałbyś móc zapytać, ale masz pewnie czas na ledwie jedno lub dwa pytania, zanim sygnał przepadnie...
links.belarusian: Ёсць так шмат усяго, пра што табе хацелася б спытаць, але ў цябе, верагодна, ёсць час толькі на адно ці два пытанні, перш чым сігнал знікне...

links.title: Interfacing: "You allow the broken hunk of metal..."
links.english: You allow the broken hunk of metal to clatter to the ground. It wasn't clear to you it did anything anyway...
links.polish: Pozwalasz zniszczonemu kawałowi metalu spaść na ziemię. I tak nie byłeś pewien, czy cokolwiek robił...
links.belarusian: Ты дазваляеш адламанай брыле металу з бразгатам упасці на зямлю. Табе і так было незразумела, ці рабіла яна хоць штосьці...

links.title: Horseback Antenna: ""Nein, Liebling!""
links.english: "Nein, Liebling!"
links.polish: „Nein, Liebling!”
links.belarusian: "Nein, Liebling!"

links.title: Noid: ""Huh. Sounds like that was a false..."
links.english: "Huh. Sounds like that was a false move. Signal's even worse now."
links.polish: „Hmm... Zdaje się, że to było kiepskie posunięcie. Sygnał jest teraz jeszcze gorszy niż wcześniej”.
links.belarusian: "Гм. Падобна, гэта быў няправільны крок. Цяпер сігнал яшчэ горшы".

links.title: You: ""That piece of junk didn't even wor..."
links.english: "That piece of junk didn't even work!"
links.polish: „Ta kawałek złomu nawet nie działał!”
links.belarusian: "Гэты кавалак бляшанкі нават не працаваў!"

links.title: Noid: ""Probably because you broke it.""
links.english: "Probably because you broke it."
links.polish: „Pewnie dlatego, że go złamałeś”.
links.belarusian: "Мусіць, таму, што ты яго зламаў".

links.title: Empathy: "He's right. This was your responsib..."
links.english: He's right. This was your responsibility...
links.polish: Ma rację. To była twoja odpowiedzialność...
links.belarusian: Ён мае рацыю. Гэта была твая адказнасць...

links.title: Noid: ""I'm going to turn all the dials to..."
links.english: "I'm going to turn all the dials to maximum. Probably gonna burn out our power supply, but that might be the only way..."
links.polish: „Podkręcę wszystkie pokrętła na maksa. Pewnie sfajczę nasze źródło zasilania, ale to może być jedyne wyjście...”
links.belarusian: "Я выкручу ўсе ручкі на максімум. Напэўна, спалю наш блок сілкавання, але гэта можа быць адзіным выйсцем..."

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "A maelstrom of sound, swirling and..."
links.english: A maelstrom of sound, swirling and swirling around an invisible point. It's mounting, mounting...
links.polish: Tornado dźwięku wirującego bez końca wokół niewidzialnego centrum. Coraz wyżej i wyżej...
links.belarusian: Вір гукаў, які кружыць і кружыць вакол нябачнай кропкі. Ён нарастае, нарастае...

links.title: Horseback Antenna: ""... nicht mehr derselbe ist, seit..."
links.english: "... nicht mehr derselbe ist, seit er auf einem Luftschiff aus Graad zurückgekommen ist..."
links.polish: „...nicht mehr derselbe ist, seit er auf einem Luftschiff aus Graad zurückgekommen ist...”
links.belarusian: "... nicht mehr derselbe ist, seit er auf einem Luftschiff aus Graad zurückgekommen ist..."

links.title: Horseback Antenna: ""... Firewalker? Please respond...""
links.english: "... Firewalker? Please respond..."
links.polish: „...Ognisty? Odpowiedz, proszę...”
links.belarusian: "...Агняход? Калі ласка, адкажыце..."

Alternate1.english: "... Officer Sunset? Please respond..."
Alternate1.polish: „...Sunset? Odpowiedz, proszę...”
Alternate1.belarusian: "...Афіцэр Сансэт? Калі ласка, адкажыце..."

Alternate2.english: "... Detective Costeau? Please respond..."
Alternate2.polish: „...Detektywie Costeau? Odpowiedz, proszę...”
Alternate2.belarusian: "...Дэтэктыў Кусто? Калі ласка, адкажыце..."

Alternate3.english: "... Lieutenant Du Bois? Please respond..."
Alternate3.polish: „...Poruczniku Du Bois? Odpowiedz, proszę...”
Alternate3.belarusian: "...Лейтэнант Дзю Буа? Калі ласка, адкажыце..."

links.title: Pain Threshold: "It's too much! Your ear drums are t..."
links.english: It's too much! Your ear drums are throbbing, about to burst!
links.polish: To zbyt wiele! Twoje bębenki pulsują, lada chwila pękną!
links.belarusian: Занадта моцна! Твае барабанныя перапонкі пульсуюць, гатовыя лопнуць!

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""... a long winter... Long and cold..."
links.english: "... a long winter... Long and cold..."
links.polish: „...długa zima... Długa i zimna...”
links.belarusian: "...доўгая зіма... Доўгая і халодная..."

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "... and then, nothing."
links.english: ... and then, nothing.
links.polish: ...a potem nic.
links.belarusian: ...а потым — нічога.

links.title: Noid: ""Try it now.""
links.english: "Try it now."
links.polish: „Spróbuj teraz”.
links.belarusian: "Паспрабуй зараз".

links.title: You: ""Coalition Warship Archer. This is..."
links.english: "Coalition Warship Archer. This is RCM Officer Firewalker. Please acknowledge."
links.polish: „Okręt Wojenny Koalicji Łucznik. Tu funkcjonariusz MOR-u, Ognisty. Potwierdź odbiór”.
links.belarusian: "Вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі "Лучнік". Гэта афіцэр РГМ Агняход. Калі ласка, пацвердзіце прыём".

Alternate1.english: "Coalition Warship Archer. This is RCM Officer Tequila Sunset. Please acknowledge."
Alternate1.polish: „Okręt Wojenny Koalicji Łucznik. Tu funkcjonariusz MOR-u, Tequila Sunset. Potwierdź odbiór”.
Alternate1.belarusian: "Вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі "Лучнік". Гэта афіцэр РГМ Тэкіла Сансэт. Калі ласка, пацвердзіце прыём".

Alternate2.english: "Coalition Warship Archer. This is Detective Costeau of the RCM. Please acknowledge."
Alternate2.polish: „Okręt Wojenny Koalicji Łucznik. Tu detektyw Raphaël Ambrosius Costeau z MOR-u. Potwierdź odbiór”.
Alternate2.belarusian: "Вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі "Лучнік". Гэта дэтэктыў Рафаэль Амброзіус Кусто з РГМ. Калі ласка, пацвердзіце прыём".

Alternate3.english: "Coalition Warship Archer. This is Lieutenant Harrier Du Bois of the RCM. Please acknowledge."
Alternate3.polish: „Okręt Wojenny Koalicji Łucznik, tu porucznik Harrier Du Bois z MOR-u. Potwierdź odbiór”.
Alternate3.belarusian: "Вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі "Лучнік". Гэта лейтэнант Гар'е Дзю Буа з РГМ. Калі ласка, пацвердзіце прыём".

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "..."
Coalition Warship Archer: ""This is... Warship Archer. We are..."
links.english: "This is... Warship Archer. We are acknowledging and accepting you... though we're still getting quite a bit of interference..."
links.polish: „Tu... Okręt Wojenny Koalicji Łucznik. Słyszymy cię i akceptujemy połączenie... chociaż odbieramy sporo interferencji...”
links.belarusian: "Гэта... вайсковы карабель "Лучнік". Мы пацвярджаем і прымаем вас... хоць у нас усё яшчэ багата перашкод..."

links.title: Noid: ""This is as good as it's going to g..."
links.english: "This is as good as it's going to get. I'll keep us aligned as long as I can, but this isn't a *social mission*, you got it?"
links.polish: „Lepiej już nie będzie. Postaram się utrzymać synchronizację jak najdłużej się da, ale to nie jest *pogawędka towarzyska*, jasne?”
links.belarusian: "Лепей ужо не будзе. Я буду трымаць суналаду колькі змагу, але гэта табе не *свецкая гутарка*, зразумеў?"

links.title: You: ""I'm sorry! I was trying to do good.""
links.english: "I'm sorry! I was trying to do good."
links.polish: „Przepraszam! Chciałem zrobić coś dobrego”.
links.belarusian: "Прабач! Я спрабаваў зрабіць як лепш".

links.title: Noid: ""The thing is, trying's not enough...."
links.english: "The thing is, trying's not enough. Now it's the results that count."
links.polish: „Problem w tym, że staranie się to za mało. Teraz liczą się tylko wyniki”.
links.belarusian: "Рэч у тым, што адных спроб мала. Цяпер важны вынік".

links.title: You: ""It's not *my* fault the statue bro..."
links.english: "It's not *my* fault the statue broke."
links.polish: „To nie *moja* wina, że posąg się sypie”.
links.belarusian: "Гэта не *мая* віна, што статуя зламалася".

links.title: Noid: ""Look, I'm not a blame-layer. I'm j..."
links.english: "Look, I'm not a blame-layer. I'm just saying, things were bad, and now they're worse."
links.polish: „Słuchaj, nikogo nie obwiniam. Po prostu wcześniej było źle, a teraz jest jeszcze gorzej”.
links.belarusian: "Слухай, я нікога не вінавачу. Я проста кажу: было дрэнна, а стала яшчэ горш".

links.title: Interfacing: "You allow the broken hunk of metal..."
links.english: You allow the broken hunk of metal to clatter to the ground. It wasn't clear to you it did anything anyway...
links.polish: Pozwalasz zniszczonemu kawałowi metalu spaść na ziemię. I tak nie byłeś pewien, czy cokolwiek robił...
links.belarusian: Ты дазваляеш адламанай брыле металу з бразгатам упасці на зямлю. Табе і так было незразумела, ці рабіла яна хоць штосьці...

links.title: You: ""What good is that supposed to do?""
links.english: "What good is that supposed to do?"
links.polish: „I jak to ma nam pomóc?”
links.belarusian: "І што добрага гэта дасць?"

links.title: Noid: ""Hmmm. Good question. Maybe he's sa..."
links.english: "Hmmm. Good question. Maybe he's saying we're casting too wide a net, got to *narrow our receiving band*, so we pick up the Big Bad without the spookers."
links.polish: „Hmm... Dobre pytanie. Może chodzi mu o to, że zarzuciliśmy sieć zbyt szeroko i powinniśmy *zawęzić nasze pasmo odbioru*, aby usłyszeć Wielkiego Złego bez straszydeł”.
links.belarusian: "Гм. Добрае пытанне. Можа, ён кажа, што мы закінулі сетку занадта шырока і трэба *звузіць нашу прыёмную паласу*, каб злавіць Вялікага Злыдня без радыёжахаў".

links.title: You: ""The connections are pretty dirty,..."
links.english: "The connections are pretty dirty, but I don't have anything to clean them with."
links.polish: „Łączenia są mocno zabrudzone, ale nie mam nic, czym mógłbym je wyczyścić”.
links.belarusian: "Кантакты даволі брудныя, але ў мяне няма чым іх пачысціць".

links.title: You: ""The connections look fine to me.""
links.english: "The connections look fine to me."
links.polish: „Łączenia wyglądają moim zdaniem dobrze”.
links.belarusian: "Як па мне, кантакты выглядаюць нармальна".

links.title: Noid: ""Huh. I don't know what to do then...."
links.english: "Huh. I don't know what to do then..."
links.polish: „Ha... W takim razie nie wiem, co teraz...”
links.belarusian: "Гм. Тады я не ведаю, што рабіць..."

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "The metal bar is cold and slick wit..."
links.english: The metal bar is cold and slick with precipitation. For a moment it feels as though you're about to slip, but you concentrate all your attention on your pectoral muscles and squeeze...
links.polish: Metalowy pręt jest zimny i śliski od deszczu. Przez moment masz wrażenie, że się ześlizgniesz, skupiasz jednak całą swoją uwagę na mięśniach piersiowych i ściskasz...
links.belarusian: Металічны дубец халодны і слізкі ад ападкаў. На імгненне здаецца, што ты вось-вось сарвешся, але ты канцэнтруеш усю ўвагу на грудных мышцах і сціскаеш...

links.title: Physical Instrument: "Don't forget the lats, champ! You'v..."
links.english: Don't forget the lats, champ! You've got this...
links.polish: Nie zapomnij o mięśniach grzbietu, chłopie! Dasz radę...
links.belarusian: Не забывай пра найшырэйшыя мышцы спіны, чэмпіён! Ты зможаш...

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "The cold metal chills your bare han..."
links.english: The cold metal chills your bare hands. Some part of your brain tells you something is missing...
links.polish: Zimny metal mrozi twoje gołe ręce. Jakaś część mózgu podszeptuje ci, że czegoś tu brakuje...
links.belarusian: Халодны метал сцюдзіць твае голыя рукі. Некая частка твайго мозгу кажа табе, што чагосьці не хапае...

links.title: Hand/Eye Coordination: "Chalk powder. Absorbs moisture and..."
links.english: Chalk powder. Absorbs moisture and keeps your grip firm.
links.polish: Magnezja. Pochłania wilgoć i zapewnia pewny chwyt.
links.belarusian: Крэйдавы парашок. Паглынае вільгаць і робіць хват надзейным.

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "... but before you can decide what,..."
links.english: ... but before you can decide what, you find yourself safely perched atop the monument.
links.polish: ...zanim jednak dociera do ciebie, czego dokładnie, docierasz bezpiecznie na szczyt pomnika.
links.belarusian: ...але перш чым ты паспяваеш вырашыць, чаго менавіта, ты ўжо бяспечна сядзіш на верхавіне помніка.

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "The cold metal chills your bare han..."
links.english: The cold metal chills your bare hands. Some part of your brain tells you something is missing...
links.polish: Zimny metal mrozi twoje gołe ręce. Jakaś część mózgu podszeptuje ci, że czegoś tu brakuje...
links.belarusian: Халодны метал сцюдзіць твае голыя рукі. Некая частка твайго мозгу кажа табе, што чагосьці не хапае...

links.title: Hand/Eye Coordination: "Chalk powder. Absorbs moisture and..."
links.english: Chalk powder. Absorbs moisture and keeps your grip firm.
links.polish: Magnezja. Pochłania wilgoć i zapewnia pewny chwyt.
links.belarusian: Крэйдавы парашок. Паглынае вільгаць і робіць хват надзейным.

links.title: Horseback Antenna: "You don't exactly cut a lithesome f..."
links.english: You don't exactly cut a lithesome figure, but after several moments of scrambling you manage to hoist yourself atop the monument.
links.polish: Popisu zwinności raczej nie dajesz, ale po kilku chwilach wysiłku udaje ci się wspiąć na szczyt pomnika.
links.belarusian: Твая постаць не адрозніваецца асаблівай гнуткасцю, але пасля некалькіх імгненняў караскання табе ўдаецца выцягнуць сябе на верхавіну помніка.

links.title: Physical Instrument: "That performance was, frankly, an e..."
links.english: That performance was, frankly, an embarrassment.
links.polish: Prawdę mówiąc, aż wstyd brał na sam widok.
links.belarusian: Гэтае відовішча, шчыра кажучы, было ганьбай.

links.title: You: ""Maybe we should try again later?""
links.english: "Maybe we should try again later?"
links.polish: „Może powinniśmy spróbować jeszcze raz później?”
links.belarusian: "Можа, паспрабуем яшчэ раз пазней?"

links.title: Noid: ""No can do. This is it. The only wa..."
links.english: "No can do. This is it. The only way forward is the hard core way, straight through. Now give it another go."
links.polish: „Nie da się. Teraz albo wcale. Jedyny sposób to hardkorowy sposób – prosto przed siebie. Spróbuj jeszcze raz”.
links.belarusian: "Не выйдзе. Усё. Адзіны шлях наперад — хардкорны шлях, напралом. А цяпер паспрабуй яшчэ раз".

links.title: You: "(Sigh.) "Coalition Warship Archer...."
links.english: (Sigh.) "Coalition Warship Archer. Do you acknowledge? This is Firewalker."
links.polish: (Westchnij). „Okręt Wojenny Koalicji Łucznik. Potwierdzacie odbiór? Tu Ognisty”.
links.belarusian: (Уздыхнуць.) "Вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі "Лучнік". Прыём чуеце? Гэта Агняход".

Alternate1.english: (Sigh.) "Coalition Warship Archer. Do you acknowledge? This is Tequila Sunset."
Alternate1.polish: (Westchnij). „Okręt Wojenny Koalicji Łucznik. Potwierdzacie odbiór? Tu Tequila Sunset”.
Alternate1.belarusian: (Уздыхнуць.) "Вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі "Лучнік". Прыём чуеце? Гэта Тэкіла Сансэт".

Alternate2.belarusian: (Уздыхнуць.) "Вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі "Лучнік". Прыём чуеце? Гэта дэтэктыў Кусто".

Alternate3.belarusian: (Уздыхнуць.) "Вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі "Лучнік". Прыём чуеце? Гэта лейтэнант Дзю Буа".

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""But someone has been maintaining i..."
links.english: "But someone has been maintaining it. The wiring has been repaired..."
links.polish: „Ale ktoś go serwisował. Okablowanie było naprawiane...”
links.belarusian: "Але нехта абслугоўваў яе. Праводка была адрамантаваная..."

Horseback Antenna: ""... Walker? Please acknowledge.""
links.english: "... Walker? Please acknowledge."
links.polish: „...Ognisty? Potwierdź odbiór”.
links.belarusian: "...ход? Калі ласка, пацвердзіце прыём".

Alternate1.english: "... Sunset? Please acknowledge."
Alternate1.polish: „...Sunset? Potwierdź odbiór”.
Alternate1.belarusian: "...Сансэт? Калі ласка, пацвердзіце прыём".

Alternate2.english: "... Costeau? Please acknowledge."
Alternate2.polish: „...Costeau? Potwierdź odbiór”.
Alternate2.belarusian: "...Кусто? Калі ласка, пацвердзіце прыём".

Alternate3.english: "... Du Bois? Please acknowledge."
Alternate3.polish: „...Du Bois? Potwierdź odbiór”.
Alternate3.belarusian: "...Дзю Буа? Калі ласка, пацвердзіце прыём".

links.english: "Archer! This is Firewalker. Can you hear me?"
links.polish: „Łucznik! Tu Ognisty. Słyszycie mnie?”
links.belarusian: "Лучнік! Гэта Агняход. Вы мяне чуеце?"

Alternate1.english: "Archer! This is Tequila Sunset. Can you hear me?"
Alternate1.polish: „Łucznik! Tu Tequila Sunset. Słyszycie mnie?”
Alternate1.belarusian: "Лучнік! Гэта Тэкіла Сансэт. Вы мяне чуеце?"

Alternate2.polish: „Łucznik! Tu detektyw Costeau. Słyszycie mnie?”
Alternate2.belarusian: "Лучнік! Гэта дэтэктыў Кусто. Вы мяне чуеце?"
