links.title: Horseback Antenna: ""Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einz..."
links.english: "Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einziges Kind..."
links.polish: „Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einziges Kind...”
links.belarusian: "Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einziges Kind..."

links.title: Horseback Antenna: ""... Warship Archer. Please identif..."
links.english: "... Warship Archer. Please identify."
links.polish: „...Wojenny Koalicji Łucznik. Zidentyfikuj się”.
links.belarusian: "...вайсковы карабель "Лучнік". Калі ласка, ідэнтыфікуйцеся".

links.title: Interfacing: "The signals are getting increasingl..."
links.english: The signals are getting increasingly mixed. Plucking Archer's signal from this will be like isolating a single strand from a tangle of hair...
links.polish: Sygnały mieszają się coraz bardziej. Wyizolowanie sygnału Łucznika będzie niczym wyplątanie pojedynczego włosa z wielkiego kłębu...
links.belarusian: Сігналы ўсё мацней перамешваюцца. Вычапіць адсюль сігнал "Лучніка" будзе ўсё адно што выцягнуць адзіную валасінку са зблытанага каўтуна...

links.title: Noid: ""This isn't looking good."  The spe..."
links.english: "This isn't looking good."  The speedfreak removes his sweat-drenched headphones. "The radio-spookers are winning."
links.polish: „Nie wygląda to dobrze” – speedziarz zdejmuje swoje przesiąknięte potem słuchawki. „Radiowe straszydła wygrywają”.
links.belarusian: "Справы кепскія". Хуткарэз здымае свае прамоклыя ад поту навушнікі. "Радыёжахі перамагаюць".

links.title: You: ""So what can we do about it?""
links.english: "So what can we do about it?"
links.polish: „I co możemy na to poradzić?”
links.belarusian: "І што мы можам з гэтым зрабіць?"

links.title: Noid: ""You just have to embrace the spook..."
links.english: "You just have to embrace the spookiness. Now give it another go."
links.polish: „Musisz po prostu pogodzić się z grozą sytuacji. Spróbuj jeszcze raz”.
links.belarusian: "Трэба проста прыняць усю гэтую жудасць. А цяпер паспрабуй яшчэ раз".

links.title: You: ""I've got a feeling this is related..."
links.english: "I've got a feeling this is related to the pale, some piece of the past that's mixing in with our signal."
links.polish: „Mam przeczucie, że jest to jakoś związane z szarotą. To jakiś fragment przeszłości wcinający się w nasz sygnał”.
links.belarusian: "У мяне адчуванне, што гэта звязана з Цьмянасцю — нейкі кавалак мінулага ўмешваецца ў наш сігнал".

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""It's been a long winter... Long an..."
links.english: "It's been a long winter... Long and cold."
links.polish: „To była długa zima... Długa i zimna...”
links.belarusian: "Гэта была доўгая зіма... Доўгая і халодная".

links.title: Noid: ""No telling, lawman. You ever confi..."
links.english: "No telling, lawman. You ever confirmed that he's, you know, *flesh and blood*?"
links.polish: „Trudno powiedzieć, stróżu prawa. Nigdy nie potwierdziłeś, że on... no wiesz... Jest *z krwi i kości*”.
links.belarusian: "Хто ведае, законнік. Ты хоць раз правяраў, ці ён, ну ведаеш, *з плоці і крыві*?"

links.title: You: ""Yeah, we've gone for an Ace's High..."
links.english: "Yeah, we've gone for an Ace's High before."
links.polish: „Tak, przybijaliśmy już kiedyś wysoką piątkę”.
links.belarusian: "Так, мы ўжо рабілі Верхні Ас".

Alternate1.english: "Yeah, we've gone for an Ace's High before..."
Alternate1.polish: „Tak, przybijaliśmy już kiedyś wysoką piątkę...”
Alternate1.belarusian: "Так, мы ўжо рабілі Верхні Ас..."

Alternate2.english: "Yeah, we've done the Ace's Low before..."
Alternate2.polish: „Tak, przybijaliśmy już kiedyś niską piątkę...”
Alternate2.belarusian: "Так, мы ўжо рабілі Ніжні Ас..."

links.title: Noid: ""Sounds like some dark cop rituals...."
links.english: "Sounds like some dark cop rituals. Don't think I want to hear any more..."
links.polish: „To mi brzmi jak jakieś mroczne gliniarskie rytuały. Chyba nie chcę wiedzieć nic więcej...”
links.belarusian: "Гучыць як нейкія змрочныя копскія рытуалы. Не думаю, што хачу чуць больш..."

links.title: You: ""I guess Kim's always had an *ether..."
links.english: "I guess Kim's always had an *ethereal* quality to him."
links.polish: „W sumie Kim zawsze miał w sobie taki element *bezcielesności*”.
links.belarusian: "Здаецца, у Кіме заўсёды было нешта *эфірнае*".

links.title: Noid: ""Could be he's your guardian spirit..."
links.english: "Could be he's your guardian spirit, your cop daemon..."
links.polish: „Może jest twoim duchowym stróżem – twoim gliniarskim daimonionem...”
links.belarusian: "Можа, ён твой дух-ахоўнік, твой копскі дэйманіён..."

links.title: You: ""I'm going to continue believing th..."
links.english: "I'm going to continue believing that Kim's just hanging out on our connection."
links.polish: „Ja jednak dalej będę uważał, że Kim po prostu przesiaduje na naszym połączeniu”.
links.belarusian: "Я буду і далей верыць, што Кім проста вісіць на нашым канале".

links.title: Noid: ""Yeah, shut your ears to the truth...."
links.english: "Yeah, shut your ears to the truth. That's the safest way forward..."
links.polish: „Taa, zignoruj prawdę. To najbezpieczniejsze podejście...”
links.belarusian: "Ага, заплюшчвай вушы на праўду. Гэта самы бяспечны шлях..."

links.title: You: ""Does that mean Kim's... *a ghost*?""
links.english: "Does that mean Kim's... *a ghost*?"
links.polish: „Czy to znaczy, że Kim jest... *duchem*?”
links.belarusian: "Гэта значыць, што Кім... *прывід*?"

links.title: You: ""What is he talking about?""
links.english: "What is he talking about?"
links.polish: „O czym on mówi?”
links.belarusian: "Пра што ён кажа?"

links.title: Noid: ""There's no sense to it. It's just..."
links.english: "There's no sense to it. It's just spooker-talk."
links.polish: „Nie doszukuj się w tym sensu. To straszydłowa gadka”.
links.belarusian: "Тут няма сэнсу. Проста балбатня жахаў".

links.title: You: ""I can't understand a word of this..."
links.english: "I can't understand a word of this gibberish."
links.polish: „Nie jestem w stanie zrozumieć z tego bełkotu ani słowa”.
links.belarusian: "Я не магу зразумець ні слова з гэтай тарабаршчыны".

links.title: Horseback Antenna: ""Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einz..."
links.english: "Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einziges Kind. Er kann doch auch nächstes Jahr zur Akademie gehen."
links.polish: „Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einziges Kind. Er kann doch auch nächstes Jahr zur Akademie gehen”.
links.belarusian: "Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einziges Kind. Er kann doch auch nächstes Jahr zur Akademie gehen."

links.title: Noid: ""Me neither. Just keep trying. We'l..."
links.english: "Me neither. Just keep trying. We'll get through these radio-spookers eventually."
links.polish: „Ja też nie. Po prostu próbuj dalej. W końcu przebijemy się przez te radiowe straszydła”.
links.belarusian: "Я таксама. Проста спрабуй далей. Урэшце мы праб'емся скрозь гэтыя радыёжахі".

links.title: You: ""What's going on?""
links.english: "What's going on?"
links.polish: „Co się dzieje?”
links.belarusian: "Што адбываецца?"

links.title: Horseback Antenna: ""Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einz..."
links.english: "Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einziges Kind. Er kann doch auch nächstes Jahr zur Akademie gehen."
links.polish: „Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einziges Kind. Er kann doch auch nächstes Jahr zur Akademie gehen”.
links.belarusian: "Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einziges Kind. Er kann doch auch nächstes Jahr zur Akademie gehen."

links.title: Noid: ""Just radio-spookers. We get them a..."
links.english: "Just radio-spookers. We get them all the time around here. Keep trying."
links.polish: „To tylko radiowe straszydła. Mamy tu z nimi bez przerwy do czynienia. Próbuj dalej”.
links.belarusian: "Проста радыёжахі. Яны тут увесь час. Спрабуй далей".

links.title: You: "Keep listening."
links.english: Keep listening.
links.polish: Słuchaj dalej.
links.belarusian: (Працягваць слухаць.)

links.title: Horseback Antenna: ""Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einz..."
links.english: "Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einziges Kind. Er kann doch auch nächstes Jahr zur Akademie gehen."
links.polish: „Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einziges Kind. Er kann doch auch nächstes Jahr zur Akademie gehen”.
links.belarusian: "Liebling, bitte… Er ist unser einziges Kind. Er kann doch auch nächstes Jahr zur Akademie gehen."

links.title: Noid: ""Keep trying. We'll get through the..."
links.english: "Keep trying. We'll get through these radio-spookers eventually."
links.polish: „Próbuj dalej. W końcu przebijemy się przez te radiowe straszydła”.
links.belarusian: "Спрабуй далей. Урэшце мы праб'емся скрозь гэтыя радыёжахі".

links.title: Rhetoric: "You can't make out a word of this g..."
links.english: You can't make out a word of this gibberish.
links.polish: Nie jesteś w stanie zrozumieć z tego bełkotu ani słowa.
links.belarusian: Ты не можаш разабраць ні слова з гэтай тарабаршчыны.

links.title: Horseback Antenna: ""Nein, Liebling! ... unseren Jungen..."
links.english: "Nein, Liebling! ... unseren Jungen... nach Vredefort ... einem dieser *Dinger*..."
links.polish: „Nein, Liebling! Unseren Jungen... nach Vredefort... einem dieser *Dinger*...”
links.belarusian: "Nein, Liebling! ... unseren Jungen... nach Vredefort ... einem dieser *Dinger*..."

links.title: Inland Empire: "I-i-is there anybody th-th-there?"
links.english: I-i-is there anybody th-th-there?
links.polish: J-j-jest tam k-kto?
links.belarusian: Ці-ці ёсць тут х-хто-небудзь?

links.title: You: ""Coalition Warship Archer, this is..."
links.english: "Coalition Warship Archer, this is RCM Officer Tequila Sunset. Please acknowledge."
links.polish: „Okręt Wojenny Koalicji Łucznik, tu funkcjonariusz MOR-u, Tequila Sunset. Potwierdź odbiór”.
links.belarusian: "Вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі "Лучнік", гэта афіцэр РГМ Тэкіла Сансэт. Калі ласка, пацвердзіце прыём".

links.title: You: ""Coalition Warship Archer, this is..."
links.english: "Coalition Warship Archer, this is Detective Raphaël Ambrosius Costeau of the RCM. Please acknowledge."
links.polish: „Okręt Wojenny Koalicji Łucznik, tu detektyw Raphaël Ambrosius Costeau z MOR-u. Potwierdź odbiór”.
links.belarusian: "Вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі "Лучнік", гэта дэтэктыў Рафаэль Амброзіус Кусто з РГМ. Калі ласка, пацвердзіце прыём".

links.title: You: ""Coalition Warship Archer, this is..."
links.english: "Coalition Warship Archer, this is Lieutenant Harrier du Bois of the RCM. Please acknowledge."
links.polish: „Okręt Wojenny Koalicji Łucznik, tu porucznik Harrier Du Bois z MOR-u. Potwierdź odbiór”.
links.belarusian: "Вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі "Лучнік", гэта лейтэнант Гар'е Дзю Буа з РГМ. Калі ласка, пацвердзіце прыём".

links.title: Shivers: "A soft rustling. Between your ears,..."
links.english: A soft rustling. Between your ears, a winterscape with fast falling snow...
links.polish: Łagodny szmer. Między twoimi uszami rozpościera się krajobraz z padającym śniegiem...
links.belarusian: Ціхі шолах. У тваёй галаве — зімовы краявід з густым снегападам...

links.title: You: ""Hold on, I need a minute.""
links.english: "Hold on, I need a minute."
links.polish: „Czekaj, potrzebuję chwili”.
links.belarusian: "Пачакай, мне трэба хвіліна".

links.title: Noid: ""No time. We're live in two... one...."
links.english: "No time. We're live in two... one..."
links.polish: „Nie ma czasu. Wchodzimy na żywo za dwa... jeden...”
links.belarusian: "Няма часу. Мы ў эфіры праз два... адзін..."

links.title: You: ""Got it. Are we ready?""
links.english: "Got it. Are we ready?"
links.polish: „Dobra. Jesteśmy gotowi?”
links.belarusian: "Зразумеў. Мы гатовыя?"
